description:
In a world where attention is the currency, focus is the unfair advantage.

Every distraction costs you momentum.
Every time you chase something new, you reset your progress.

You don’t need more ideas.
You need the discipline to stay with the one that works.
transcript: All you need is a spark. You need to choose that needle mover you're going to do today. Go talk to AI, talk to Gigi, talk to ChatGBT, talk to Claude, whatever one you like using, and just start today with, this is my goal, this is my constraint. Do you think you can help me think through it? Because I want to accomplish one thing today. If you complete one thing each day, it not only moves you forward, it becomes the momentum, it becomes the priority. And the clarity starts by just narrowing down what that one thing should be.
spoken_hook_0_3s: All you need is a spark. You need to choose that need.
first_sentence: All you need is a spark.
